categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures various copper alloy sheets for domestic and international sales, including brass sheets, red copper sheets, high-performance copper sheets, tin-plated copper sheets, and other specialty alloys. It operates divisions in metal industry manufacturing, electronics industry manufacturing, steel industry manufacturing, and construction-related businesses. The company also engages in import-export and agency trade related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical processes including melting, hot pressing, surface grinding, acid pickling, and precision rolling to produce copper alloy sheets. It focuses on developing high-strength, high-conductivity copper alloys, low internal stress etching materials, and environmentally friendly tin-plated copper materials. R&D efforts include process optimization for thick red copper heat dissipation materials and new alloy development for lithium battery packs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor manufacturers, automotive parts suppliers, LED industry players, and server and AI computing hardware producers. The company serves markets in Taiwan, China, Southeast Asia, Japan, and India, with products used in electronic connectors, automotive terminals, heat dissipation components, and battery materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and sales offices in Taipei and Taichung. It exports to China, Southeast Asia, Japan, and is expanding into the Indian market. The company faces competitive challenges in China and Southeast Asia due to local producers and tariff barriers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the copper alloy supply chain, producing copper alloy sheets and materials that are further processed by precision stamping manufacturers (downstream) and used by electronic, semiconductor, automotive, and electrical appliance industries (end markets).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-strength, high-conductivity copper alloys for semiconductor and AI/server applications, expanding high-end tin-plated copper materials for automotive connectors, and promoting copper-nickel-silicon and copper-chromium-zirconium alloys. R&D focuses on improving product quality, yield, and environmental sustainability, including solar power integration and carbon reduction initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of copper alloy sheets and related materials. The company also earns income from financial investments and dividends. It does not engage in subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds approximately 30% market share in Taiwan's copper alloy market and over 60% in high-performance and specialty alloys. It faces competition from Chinese manufacturers in general-purpose products and from domestic and Chinese producers in tin-plated copper materials. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology from Mitsubishi, stable quality recognized by Japanese automotive manufacturers, and diversified product offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company achieved revenues of approximately NT$3.13 billion with a net profit of NT$265.6 million. It showed significant growth compared to the previous year, driven by increased sales volume and improved product mix. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets exceeding NT$9 billion and equity of NT$7.17 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable, high-quality copper alloy materials tailored for high-end applications such as automotive connectors, semiconductor etching, and AI/server heat dissipation. It differentiates through advanced alloy development, environmental sustainability efforts, and strong customer relationships, particularly in high-performance and specialty copper alloys that are difficult for competitors to replicate.
